name: Co-beneldopa (Levodopa + Benserazide)
dosing: Start 50/12.5mg TDS-QDS, titrate to response. Max 200/800mg daily
contraindications: Concurrent use of non-selective MAO inhibitors; known hypersensitivity
interactions: Antipsychotics that antagonise dopamine may reduce efficacy; exact interactions mirror those of other levodopa preparations
monitoring: Assess motor response, dyskinesia, blood pressure for orthostatic hypotension, and other dopaminergic side effects; adjust dose accordingly
pregnancy: Use only if essential with specialist advice
sideEffects: Nausea, orthostatic hypotension, dyskinesia with long-term use, hallucinations/psychosis in susceptible individuals
pharmacokinetics: Levodopa is converted to dopamine centrally; benserazide inhibits peripheral decarboxylation increasing central availability
clinicalPearls: Equivalent efficacy to co-careldopa for symptomatic management of Parkinson's; choose formulation based on patient response and tolerability
